purpose: Teach: 開運/バレル/得票/ウエート/態様/勝率/内務省/文教

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、初詣警備で市民の開運を支えられますね
lines.en: The police support citizens' good fortune during New Year shrine visits, don't they.
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. Genuine appreciation for the work. Delivered as a statement phrased as a gentle question—not seeking confirmation but acknowledging something true. Even pace, steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、原油バレル価格高騰時の盗難にも対応されますね
lines.en: The police handle theft cases even during oil price spikes, don't they.
lines.style: Same warm register. A touch more specific—noting the complexity of responding to economic pressures. Slight emphasis on the scope of their responsibility. Measured, thoughtful delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、選挙の得票集計の警備もされますね
lines.en: The police provide security for vote counting during elections too, don't they.
lines.style: Continuing the pattern. Light acknowledgment of yet another civic responsibility. No strain in the voice—this is simply how things work. Calm, steady throughline.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査の重点ウエートを決められますね
lines.en: The police set priorities for where investigative resources go, don't they.
lines.style: Tone shifts slightly toward the analytical. Recognising decision-making weight. Slower pace here—each phrase deliberate. Still warm, but now with a hint of understanding the difficulty of the choice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪の態様別に班を作られますね
lines.en: The police organize teams based on the type of crime they're dealing with, don't they.
lines.style: Back to steady appreciation. Straightforward observation of operational structure. No sense of discovery—this is obvious once you think about it. Calm, declarative.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯人検挙の勝率を上げる工夫もされますね
lines.en: The police work to improve their success rate in apprehending suspects, don't they.
lines.style: A touch warmer here—recognising effort and innovation. The 「工夫」 carries admiration. Not celebratory, but genuinely noticing the commitment. Measured pace with a gentle lift.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、旧内務省時代の歴史的事案も整理されますね
lines.en: The police also organize historical records from the old Home Ministry era, don't they.
lines.style: Tone becomes more reflective. This is about institutional memory and continuity. Slightly slower. A sense of looking backward with care. Still warm, but now tinged with the weight of history.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、文教施設での防犯活動も担当されますね
lines.en: The police handle crime prevention at schools and educational facilities, don't they.
lines.style: Voice softens noticeably here. Protecting children and learning spaces carries different weight. Gentler attack on the opening words. Slower pace. Quiet care underneath the observation.
